text:
jess: heads up — after the 11:30 deploy I'm seeing a bunch of tenants with invoice deltas. console shows sampling=0.05 for them but invoice lines don't have sku_tag attached.
omar: hmm. which deploy? the routing PR or the metering schema change?
jess: the metering-protobuf change (PR #4428). it added `pricing_unit` but I think `sku_tag` got renamed in the proto and the downstream transformer expects the old field.
liam: can you paste the offending log?
jess: here: ```WARN transformer: missing field 'sku_tag' for event_id=ev_9a3b
raw_event: {"tenant":"acme","tokens":342,"pricing_unit":1,"time":1680000000}```
sasha: oh no — that means the billing-join step doesn't emit the route_tag so invoice-generator treats it as generic usage and attributes to default_sku.
metering-bot: alert generated: metering-transformer-missing-sku 178 events in 10m for service=hosted-api
jess: I rolled a hotfix locally by mapping `pricing_unit` -> `sku_tag` as a temporary shim, but we need a proper contract fix.
omar: what's the smallest blast radius rollback? can we revert the proto bump in the converter service only?
liam: revert early, yes — but we also need to reprocess the ~2k events flagged. replays are tricky because the ledger dedupe hash uses event_signature which depends on sku_tag.
sasha: can we derive a deterministic fallback sku_tag for replays (e.g., tenant_default + pricing_unit) so ledger hashes line up?
liam: maybe, but that will change hashes — ledger will see them as new claims. we should instead rehydrate original messages from raw-kinesis-archive and rerun transformer with shim so hashes match original missing-sku runs.
jess: plan: 1) revert proto bump in converter (safe deploy) 2) deploy shim mapping in transformer 3) run backfill on archived events for window 2026-03-12T11:25..11:50 4) validate invoice preview diffs on staging then prod.
omar: tagging @sasha for console validation — we need dashboard card showing sku_tag population rate + untagged percentage. put it on the metering health panel. :eyes:
sasha: will add a quick metric: `metering.sku_tag_missing_ratio` and a Grafana alert at 1% sustained.
liam: also capture example event IDs for auditing and downstream legal. jess can you paste 5 sample ev ids to #incidents?
jess: done — posted in incidents. I kicked off the revert. deploy-bot: deploy started: converter-service v3.4.1 -> v3.3.8 (rollback)
metering-bot: replay job queued: archive-backfill-run-20260312-1140 (expected duration ~45m)
omar: great. after replay, run invoice reconciliation on sample tenant set (10 orgs) and compare token counts + sku line attribution before/after. if diffs > 0.5% escalate.
sasha: will update console rollout notes for tomorrow's oncall and add a brief blurb in the runbook about proto contract changes and consumer compatibility.
jess: thanks all — will keep updates here. :thumbsup:
liam: thanks. ping if you need help with replays or ledger tooling.
